sections.name: header
lines: Title: container-type CSS property - CSS | MDN
Use only ids from this observation. Scroll with scroll("down", 1600, element_id=<id>).

sections.name: content
lines: - This feature is well established and works across many devices and browser versions. It’s been available across browsers since February 2023.
- * Some parts of this feature may have varying levels of support.
- The property specifies the type of container context used in a container query.
